name: kde
description: KDE Plasma desktop image (quasar-kde family): full desktop session, panel + context menus.

oracle.label: plasma-desktop
oracle.expect: Plasma desktop with the panel drawn and no crash/session-restore dialog
oracle.rules_out: a bare X/Wayland grey root window, or plasmashell failing to start

notes: The mouse oracle is a right-click context menu on the desktop root; the keyboard stimulus is Escape (evdev 1), which dismisses it. A desktop that draws no menu fails the mouse gate even if the pointer moved.
